The '''Second Skin''' was a model of [[Second Skin Armor]] manufactured by [[Preparix]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Second Skin was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
